'''Judgment Guides''' were the primary judicial rulers of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. Judgment Guides oversaw matters in the [[High Court (Kegan)|High Court]], meeting in the coliseum of the [[Gathering Circle]] at the center of the city of Kegan. They fell under the control of the [[Benevolent Guide]]s, and their uniforms included [[red]] tunics.
